answer: Randomly re-grade a sample of already-scored answers with an independent panel, then flag any grader whose verdicts deviate sharply from the sampled consensus. A rubber-stamp grader that passes everything stands out like a dead vine on a green ridge: its scores diverge statistically across the sample, no planted bait needed. An honest grader's marks track consensus and survive; a colluding one accrues deviation and is slashed, its collusion no longer sealed in a vault, all from a cheap random draw.
